home-description: I work in the sustainability sector, turning data into impact: I support the creation of ESG reports for companies and third parties by developing, automating, and optimizing backend data-processing systems. At the same time, I help SMEs and individuals digitize their business in a practical, no-stress way, covering the entire process end to end. From the initial consultation to delivering tailored digital tools. Professional websites, data management and analytics, automation, and AI integration: all with a clear, fast, results-oriented approach.

services-card-consulting-desc: A space to listen, understand, and turn your needs into a concrete plan. Together we map goals, constraints, and opportunities, then design a practical solution you can execute with clarity and confidence.

services-card-consulting-bullet3: AI strategy: use-cases, risks, adoption plan

services-card-digitalSolutions-desc: From idea to launch: modern websites and tailored tools built for performance, maintainability, and growth. A pragmatic approach, fast delivery without sacrificing quality.
